title: A reviewer says your agent is not production-ready
prompt: It retrieves and summarizes in two steps with no fallback. What is the minimum fix?

options.text: Add a thinking or transformation step to reach three discrete steps beyond retrieval, plus explicit fallback for low-confidence or out-of-scope questions.
options.feedback: Correct. Both are hard requirements: three or more discrete steps including a thinking step, and explicit error handling with defined fallback.

options.text: Switch to a larger model so answers improve.
options.feedback: No. Model size does not satisfy the step-count or fallback requirements, and larger models should be reserved for where reasoning clearly benefits.

options.text: Enable all previous steps memory everywhere.
options.feedback: No. Too much memory leads to slower, more expensive runs with wandering answers, and it does not add a fallback path.
